task_description:
# Keyboard Shortcuts

Implement comprehensive keyboard shortcuts for common actions: camera presets (1-4), tool selection, undo/redo, save, play/pause animation.

## Rationale
Power users want fast access to common operations without clicking through menus. Keyboard shortcuts enable fluid presentation flow during team meetings.

## User Stories
- As a presenter, I want to quickly switch camera views with number keys during meetings
- As a power user, I want keyboard shortcuts for faster workflow

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Camera preset shortcuts (1, 2, 3, 4)
- [ ] Tool shortcuts (S for select, D for draw, etc.)
- [ ] Ctrl+S to save, Ctrl+Z to undo
- [ ] Spacebar for play/pause animation
- [ ] Keyboard shortcut help overlay (? key)
- [ ] Shortcuts don't conflict with browser defaults
